notes.title: BeetleQuest 2023 will be a free update!
notes.notes:
After speaking with Steam and some deliberations, we have decided to make BeetleQuest 2023 a free update for the existing game BeetleQuest.

We initially decided to make a new game page for BeetleQuest 2023, as it is a complete remake. Every background and animation has been redone, and many things have been added, like new story content and voice-acting.

But after some deliberations, we have decided to make it a free update for our game BeetleQuest.

The update will be coming in the near future, and it will come with a slight increase in price as well. But it will be totally free for the current owners of BeetleQuest!

We are quite excited about the results of our efforts, and we hope to bring you much point & click goodness, and lots of beetles!

notes.title: Small improvements & bug fix
notes.notes:
A 'skip' button has been added to the starting, scrolling image. You can now open and close your inventory using the mouse wheel.

The flower duplication bug has been fixed, we are still looking if it is engine related.
